leftEvidence.title: Image, creator, head, beginning, firstborn, fullness, and reconciliation accumulate

points.label: Title sequence
points.left: Firstborn from the dead follows creator, sustainer, head, and beginning language.
points.right: Firstborn of the dead follows faithful witness and precedes ruler of earth’s kings.

points.label: Consequences
points.left: Preeminence, fullness, reconciliation, and peace through cross-blood follow.
points.right: Release from sins, kingdom and priests, coming, seeing, and mourning follow.

payload.posture: Keep each Scripture witness intact, inspect what each states, and do not supply a combined sequence the sources do not author.

rightEvidence.title: Faithful witness, firstborn, ruler, liberator, coming one, and divine title accumulate

payload.tension: The shared firstborn title appears inside different literary sequences and supports different surrounding claims.
payload.title: Firstborn within creation / firstborn within witness and rule
